description: This Java class defines a custom Swing JPanel subclass called JPanelWithListener that manages a list of MouseListeners, allowing adding, removing, and clearing listeners as well as removing all child components.

classes.name: JPanelWithListener
classes.description: A custom JPanel that keeps track of MouseListeners added to it, enabling bulk operations like removing all listeners.

methods.name: JPanelWithListener
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the panel with a specified layout manager.

methods.name: addMouseListener
methods.description: Overrides the method to add a MouseListener and keep track of it in an internal list.

methods.name: removeMouseListener
methods.description: Overrides the method to remove a MouseListener and update the internal list accordingly.

methods.name: removeAllMouseListeners
methods.description: Removes all MouseListeners registered in the internal list.

methods.name: removeAllChildrenAndListeners
methods.description: Removes all child components and clears all MouseListeners.
